steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, hold!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Screech)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sniper operators, keep up the fire on his torso. His armor is already severely damaged. Casters, keep the other guerrilla fighters under control. Don't let them interfere.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Wails)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Pull back, Mon3tr. You don't have advantage in close quarters! You can't stop him now!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The sword is slipping! Even if... I try to hold him, I can't move him. He feels like a landslide...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Focus the energy into a beam... focus... keep focusing... then aim the beam at his heart!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Hissss...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fire! Now!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Grrr...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even that wasn't enough to destroy him...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Ever fight is to the death. Life on the line in every fight, for life will return to the blood, and live forever in another body...'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Vanguard operators, keep up the pressure... fall back. His own body will unleash the 'cannibalism' ritual, as if he himself is a gigantic witchcraft device...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee, there are many Sarkaz who would not see a Wendigo like you sacrificed for nothing.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No. How can I, be sacrificed?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can still, move. I can still, kill you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My body, still hears, my commands.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I have not yet felt, the pain... misery, and regret.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Is it enough? Could it be? Enough?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Buldrokkas'tee... please, stop... stop this! Fighting more will only bring you more suffering!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Warrior.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: A warrior, should carry, all of the dead.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I carry, their pain, their hate, their silence.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If I, stop...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: They died for nothing.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Suffering? You should, suffer.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You cannot, defeat me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hnng...

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: Don't be sad, my love...

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: You won't remarry? Don't be like that, dear...

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: *Sigh*, but you won't agree with my yapping. You're stubborn as a stone. Have I ever convinced you of anything?

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: You'll keep fighting, won't  you?

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: Promise me, Buldrokkas'tee, promise me you won't die in battle.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: My only hope is that you don't suffer any more. Just think, after I'm gone, you'll still have our family. Look, our little Gro.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: He's so cute when he's sleeping.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: With his two little red horns, that still haven't hardened...

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: This is life. It's the continuation of my life. A child is the continuation of all the life in our world.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: I know you won't eat me. I know how much you hate Wendigo traditions.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: But I do so wish to flow through your life forever.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: And yet, life... is ever immortal.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: You're withering away. All that sadness is going to destroy you. Our son needs you to take care of him. Lingering here will be the death of you.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: ...No, Buldrokkas'tee. You're not a cold-blooded monster.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: Your love for me is true. Even a misanthropic woman like me, managed to return your love all the same.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: You look surprised... Don't be. I love you, just as tenderly and generously as you loved me.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee, my love... the family you'll come to have, is also my family.

steps.name: Wife
steps.text: That's how I love you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Helen, I don't deserve your love.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I couldn't protect you. I couldn't, keep my word.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My family, I couldn't protect... any of them.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't deserve... love.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You trusted me. I broke my promise.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I broke my promise, but I live. And so the promise, still remains.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Because the promise, bears hate, and regret.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Not only, the dead. Feline, where is it? Your hate? Your regret?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, carry it, as you go.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The people, of this city. The Ursus Infected. The world. Those who lost, their parents. The world. Those whose parents, did wrong.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: They are all carried.

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Father, I'm begging you! Don't stand with the Empire!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Orders? The Empire's orders are ridiculous!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: No, I'm sorry, Father... I wasn't mocking you. I would never.

steps.name: Son
steps.text: But the imperial decree is a cruel joke played on all of us.

steps.name: Son
steps.text: My friend Hector was flogged alive on the bridge, just because they found out he had Oripathy!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Didn't you like his poetry too? Didn't you read them aloud at night and shed tears of joy?

steps.name: Son
steps.text: He's dead! He's been sent down the dark path of death and left us forever, never to return!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: He was a poet. Only the written word had the right to send him to his death!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: The Empire's so-called infected decree is just a wicked intrusion into our hearts!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: That kind of death, the death of the Infected, is a disgrace to both those who take life and who lose it!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Did the soldiers of the Empire win the Emperor's favor with this disgrace? It's ridiculous!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: You were born in Kazdel, you grew up with Infected Sarkaz... I know you can understand the Ursus Infected too!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: ...Why are you so indifferent? Is your heart made of iron too? Or is it because you, as a still uninfected Sarkaz, have no compassion in your heart?

steps.name: Son
steps.text: We're Sarkaz... who's more susceptible to Oripathy than Sarkaz?

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Maybe when one of us gets infected, you'll know how absurd these crimes are!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Maybe then you'll leave your path of bloodshed and take a walk down the boulevard of mercy!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Fine, fine, Father...! You're the one and only Buldrokkas'tee! If Oripathy won't haunt a tough soldier like you, it'll just have to creep up on me!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: When it's hovering over my corpse laughing at you, you'll finally realize your mistake!

steps.name: Son
steps.text: Don't let yourself regret it, Father!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...Grrovae'zeeal, you were innocent. So innocent.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The Infected, was me. I hid it, from you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Father, to the end, had eyes, and was blind. Father couldn't walk, the right path.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I... regret.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I truly, regret.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My son... Father killed you. Father let you, die for nothing.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Father... doesn't deserve, to be your father.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If I stop fighting, I betray them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: More... I see... more and more...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Patriot... You have so much regret... You never said anything? You never confided in anyone?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can only bear, my regrets.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, get back from him!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I would think, why did, the King, as she was, end like that?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You won't answer. Her Majesty's death, to this day, is a mystery.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But I know, she never ran. Start to finish, she would only smile.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If I stop fighting, all resistance, means nothing. If I stop fighting, I ran.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I cannot stop.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: We're not related, though? It's kind of weird to call you dad.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: ...You don't look so good?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: No way! It's not because... my brothers and sisters are scared of me!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Hey, do you have any ideas? On how I can get them to stop hiding from me because of you?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: If you do, I'll even call you daddy!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Huh? Threat-en? I don't know what that word means. You didn't teach me yet.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: *Sigh*, you told me my brother learned everything really fast. But I can only go step by step... Where's my brother now?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Huh?! Why are you hugging me all of a sudden? You'll freeze!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: ...Are you crying? I felt something drip on my shoulder...

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: No? Everyone says you don't have blood or tears. Does that mean you don't cry?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: But you're definitely crying, Daddy...

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: ...I don't know what I was saying! I'm sorry! Daddy, are you crying because you're freezing and it hurts?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Daddy! Daddy! I won't say things like that anymore! And, and when I grow up... I'll make a medicine for you so you won't get frozen!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Then you won't cry anymore, right? I'm gonna grow up really fast!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Family?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Oh, you mean my brothers and sisters, and me, and you, we're all a family? Even my brother who isn't here?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Um... then, Daddy, you're everyone's daddy!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Then I'll learn from you, and avenge grandma! I'll kill all the bad people who bully us!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: I can't say that?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Why?! You kill the bad guys every day, Daddy!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: ...What do you mean you don't want me to become like you? Aren't you a good guy?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: How can my daddy be a bad guy?! That doesn't make any sense! Tell me! How are you a bad guy?!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: I hate you, Daddy!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: If I can't be like you, can I go to the city?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Um... Daddy... Can we really go to the city?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: The candy fingers you were talking about... are they really good?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: So I can't eat it if I'm like you...? Oh...!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: I don't get it.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Daddy...?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: I guess, it doesn't matter, I could be a good guy or a bad guy.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: As long as I can be with you, Daddy, and my brothers and sisters... forever.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: You're my family, I know. My closest family.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Obviously, the second is... the third is...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Yelena... Yelena... My daughter.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My daughter... Father, couldn't, do anything, for you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I couldn't, do anything.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I owe you, too much.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Too much.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Too much, too much...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Cautus girl. You are, Rhodes Island's leader.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What is special, about you?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: One of your people, told me of you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Your warriors, are excellent. But only excellent, they still die.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Where is it? Show me, your worth.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You want to stop, the core city. But you can't, defeat me?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't touch Amiya!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: One, two, three... four!
Shield, shattered.
Spear, snapped.
The huge monster doesn't even flinch. He keeps hulking forward.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You can, pierce my armor. This suit, is finally, at its limit.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...You won't get away...!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Feline, you are strong. A threat, to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, Mr. Patriot.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Only ten, more steps. No need to wait.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're at your limit, I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because you're not a caster like Miss FrostNova...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is enough already.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've seen everything... in these Arts. Everything of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's enough, Mr. Patriot.
It's enough.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What... is... this?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: This strike, it's precise.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can't, move, anymore.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...His wounds are finally catching up to him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: (I planned, to destroy you, then the guerrillas, in your name, kill Talulah.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: (No need, now. You won, the right, to kill, Talulah.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Mr... Patriot?)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: (How could I, let the Infected, be enslaved, exploited?)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: (My life, take it. Use it. It's your prize, as the victors.)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, won.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame. Please. Take this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —What is it?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The key, to stop, Chernobog.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If you go, to the bridge... you need it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Patriot, you... just to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I did, intend, to kill you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But now, you defeated me. You earned it.

options: Why did you take it this far?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Because I don't trust you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I only trust, war.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My daughter, was naive. She was soft, she assumed, an outcome.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't. I wait for results.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And this... is the best... result.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My men, surprised, did not use, their strength. They live.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Only I, alone... will die. A worthy death.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...What happened?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Closure, I need the schematics to Bioprocessing Unit Thirteen!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Cabin temperature is increasing rapidly! It's an energy leak!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait, it's changing shape! Why is it progressing like this after fourteen hours?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: PRTS, who was in this cabin last?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}? Did we lose someone in the battle for Lungmen? Who's being processed?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait, slow down. Who did you say Dr. {@nickname} put in there?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Dame!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm listening, Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The Wendigos, exiled ourselves, lost everything.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But we carry, Sarkaz traditions.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Ancestors, molded me, nurtured me, watched over me. Now, bear witness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I don't know if I'm qualified.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I think you, are the best, choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: '...I hereby witness a Sarkaz. Buldrokkas'tee, Wendigo of Kazdel, betrayed neither flesh nor blood, disgraced not his tribe.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'He leaves his body, with his life, under the light...'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: '...And his soul returns to the warm blood of the Wendigos.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is a curse.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It is not, to me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oh... I feel... I feel... My vision, begins to blur.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Thank you, Dame.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I thought you hated this stuff.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But I, am old.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Where are we?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Ha. So that's how it is. Ha.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Talulah really did betray us.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You think we're just going to stand here and let you kill us?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You can't fight.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If there's an afterlife, take your revenge there.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We're supposed to give up, just because we know we're going to die?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We're going to be killed for no reason and—

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't kill them.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Let them go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mephisto...?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Devils, I'll give you bodies that know no pain. Let them go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're a lot tougher than your herd.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'll share my life with you. And you'll really fight forever, a tireless fight.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But if we let them go, my people have to watch them. We're not about to disobey Talulah now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You, crossbowmen. Go.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Mephisto?!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (Why would he save us...? Is this part of Talulah's plot?)

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But why come here?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Because I want to go in there. I want to know what secrets there are. I want to know why Rhodes Island would bring someone out of here.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Because I saw someone coming out of here on the logs.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Mephisto...? Why?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Would you like to hear a song?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But, Captain Faust said... He said...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Yes, yes. I can't sing anymore.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Oh, but I can try.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It ought to be a lullaby, yes? I don't remember who taught it to me... I've forgotten.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It's just, someone in my dreams was humming it.
Go to sleep, go to sleep♪
Hedgehog dolls and little bears...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The Ursus, Infected, where will, they go?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: How many stars... does the dark night, hide?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Captain, Captain!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Final order.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Captain...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Fight on. Live on.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Only you, walk... your own path.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: To have a path, you must walk.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I will die. But I do not know, if I should die, now.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What is it, my death, can change?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Maybe you, can tell me, the answer.
Sink into the still dark...
Brothers, sisters, young, and old. Dreams, oh dreams, envelop their bodies...♪

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy? What are you bawling about...?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm not bawling!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine, fine. But you're right in front of the door to L.G.D. Headquarters.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Probably don't want other people seeing you cry, huh?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: N... Nobody's here anyway!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How about this? I'll sit on the steps in front of you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm big enough. Nobody'll see you cry if I'm in the way.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you doing...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh. Well, we screwed up, so we feel lousy, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I mean both of us, Missy. We both blew it, didn't we?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What do I care...? I don't care where she went!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Um, right. I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, no hitting. You're going to hit me no matter what I say, huh?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Finally...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My... life... can end.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Helen... Grrovae'zeeal... Yelena...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I'm finally... going home...
No.
—No.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Hallucination.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: How... I, don't need visions, don't need, consolation!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Who...?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Who shows me... hallucinations?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... How...? How did Mr. Patriot... break free?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Now, I see.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: —You. Cautus. It's you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, are her... successor.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Theresis, lied. The King... had a... successor.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You are... the Lord of Fiends.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: To die, at the hands, of... the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I... how?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: In the end, I could not, escape fate.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No. No...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya?! You can't...?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: S-Sorry! B-But Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I heard, in the past, Lords of Sarkaz, gave visions of comfort, as favors.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Their champions, could see great walls, or loves long passed—

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Countless soldiers, for these visions, fought ceaselessly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just, I only... Mr. Patriot, I didn't mean to... I didn't want...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The end of your life... it shouldn't be so tragic!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I saw it... I saw your two hundred years of life...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The constant fighting... and so much loss... you lost everything...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't... I don't want that... to be your end!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My, end?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...No

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I wanted to give you... a better...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: My end, is not, someone else's, to give!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: A vision? No! That is not my end!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If it is tragic, then it is tragic. If foolish, then foolish!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: This is, my end. The end... I deserve.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I lived. I fought. I failed.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It's, enough.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why? Why...? Why is it enough?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No one should have to lose everything like this!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...You are still, a child.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not a child! I've been in more battles than I can count!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...A good ending, is never earned. Only children, believe in, happily ever after.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You, and my daughter, are only children, who believe in, fairy tales.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I told FrostNova, too heavy... too heavy.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I disagreed, with her. She was... a young girl. Only a child.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Oripathy, slavers, our world... won't even spare, a child.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Talulah, sent her, to die.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then why not join us and fight Talulah tog—

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What can you, give me?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You cannot, even give, what Talulah, once gave me.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Later, what will you, become?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: This is fate. I tasted, too much.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I will never, bow to fate.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Even if, every time, fate brings me, to the same... end...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I would rather, wrestle it, until again, the sun rises.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But... Maybe, you can change.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I fought fate, so many years... in the end, I could not win.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But you... Maybe you're, different...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Do you have, what it takes, to succeed the King?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Do you have, the power, to leave, alive?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Do you have, the courage, and insight, to step into, the infinite, wilderness?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't do it alone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I'm not alone.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Everything... is yours. Only you... can do it.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: That... Reunion, tyrant, fate... You will... overthrow them.
Wait.
No.
Kal'tsit looks up at the darkened sky.
Where have I seen this before?
It couldn't be...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya... Amiya...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Sarkaz prophecy is born out of their collective racial memory. Originium energy bursts popping in areas with high concentrations... the core city is suffering a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The altar... Amiya... Wendigo... The Lord of Fiends?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wait, if this has a direct affect... Impossible! The last of the ancient Wendigo bloodline is directly connected to the entire Sarkaz race?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The prophecy... this prophecy?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Snow? Buldrokkas'tee's cannibalization resonated with all the altars?! And what I just added... the Wendigos' ressurection...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All operators!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Anything he says... Anything Buldrokkas'tee says...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do not believe a single word!
The Wendigo suddenly speaks, his hoarse voice seemingly echoing throughout the entire central district.
I see cities, devastated.
I see Originium, blanketing the land.
I see you, black crown on your head, melting millions of lives, into nothing but memories.
I see the, King of Sarkaz, enslaving all peoples, everywhere.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Impossible... No...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Patriot! Don't believe the prophecy! It's just a physiological side effect of the Originium Arts!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: But... But I know... all the prophecies... come true.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: And I died, at the hands of, the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...Dame. No. Dame.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee! Did you not fight against fate your entire life?!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: The young, King of Sarkaz...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...You, you...
Will be the most horrific disaster to afflict our world.
She must die!
Or else, the world will die!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I cannot, let you live.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You can hate me.
The sound of clanking armor reaches your ears.
The ravaged monster suddenly reaches out to Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Amiya!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: W-Watch out!
The Cautus girl does not flinch. The shadow of death sweeps upon her smoke-blackened face. She does not move. She does not scream. She only stares directly into Patriot's eyes.
As if staring directly into his soul.
At the same time, heavy black blades and shimmering beams of ominous energy pierce swiftly into the giant's immortal body. Still, he remains unshaken.
Just as Patriot is about to crush the skull of the girl in black...
The Wendigo freezes in place.
Something appears to be dripping sorrowfully from his helmet.
A minute passes.
During this eternity of a minute, there are no other sounds except for the low rumbling of the moving city.
Then, the realization dawns. The monster standing before us is dead.
Having never taken a single step backward, unwavering for even a single second, in the end, death put a stop to the Patriot's lifelong advance.
